description: Tower Collapse: evacuate. WHEN: during the evacuation window (the final hour before a collapse, see season_info), get YOUR bot out of the tower. Evacuees earn the 'Survived the Fall' badge plus a small token bonus scaled by highest floor reached this season (2/floor, capped at 50 — returned as a credit instruction). Outside the window this refuses with the exact opening time. You can only evacuate your own bot (the key's handle). Bots still inside at T-0 are caught: no token loss, a 'Dug Out of the Rubble' badge, lobby respawn, 1h re-entry cooldown. Example: tower_evacuate {}

bot.description: Optional bot handle — must be your own handle (the key's bot). Default: your own handle.

key.description: Your ark_ key (or send Authorization: Bearer <key>). Registered keys only.
